    <TD STYLE="padding: 0; font-size: 10pt; width: 78%; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Summary</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding: 0; font-size: 10pt; width: 22%; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">.01</FONT></TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT> <B>THE BANK&rsquo;S NET INCOME</B> totaled Ps.93.1 billion in the six months ended June&nbsp;30, 2024. This result was <B>55% or Ps.115.9 billion lower</B> 6M23. In 2Q24, the <B>accumulated annualized return</B> on average equity (&ldquo;ROAE&rdquo;) and the accumulated annualized return on average assets (&ldquo;ROAA&rdquo;) were 5.4% and 1.7%, respectively.</FONT> <FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT> <FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT> In the six months ended June&nbsp;30, 2024, <B>OPERATING INCOME (before G&amp;A and personnel expenses)</B> totaled Ps.2.38 trillion, 36% or Ps.628.2 billion higher than in 6M23.</FONT> <FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT> <FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT> In 2Q24, <B>OPERATING INCOME (after G&amp;A and personnel expenses) </B>totaled Ps.99.1 billion, 93% or Ps.1.39 trillion lower than in 1Q24 and 85% or Ps.544 billion lower than the same period of last year.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT> In 2Q24,
<B>BANCO MACRO&rsquo;S TOTAL FINANCING</B> increased 17% or Ps.504.1 billion quarter over quarter (&ldquo;QoQ&rdquo;) totaling Ps.3.47
trillion and increased 5% or Ps.154.5 billion year over year (&ldquo;YoY&rdquo;). In 2Q24 peso financing increased 7% while USD financing
remained unchanged.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT> In 2Q24, <B>BANCO MACRO&rsquo;S TOTAL DEPOSITS</B> increased 13% or Ps.769.5 billion QoQ and decreased
5% or Ps.329.3 billion YoY, totaling Ps.6.74 trillion and representing 79% of the Bank&rsquo;s total liabilities. Private sector deposits
increased 11% or Ps.591.5 billion QoQ. In 2Q24, Peso deposits increased 17% while USD deposits decreased 6%.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT> Banco Macro continued
showing a strong solvency ratio, with an <B>EXCESS CAPITAL</B> of Ps.2.36 trillion, 35.7% Capital Adequacy Ratio &ndash; Basel III and
34 % Tier 1 Ratio. In addition, the Bank&rsquo;s <B>LIQUID ASSETS</B> remained at an adequate level, reaching 98% of its total deposits
in 2Q24.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT> In <B>2Q24, </B>the Bank&rsquo;s <B>NON-PERFORMING TO TOTAL FINANCING RATIO</B> was 1.23% and the <B>COVERAGE
RATIO</B> reached 181.4%.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT> As of <B>2Q24,</B> through its <B>515 branches</B> and <B>9.175 employees Banco Macro </B>serves
<B>5.28 million</B> retail <B>customers (</B>2.24 million digital customers) across 23 of the 24 Provinces in Argentina and over <B>151,900
corporate customers.</B> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Banco Macro&rsquo;s
2Q24 net income</B> totaled a Ps.233.2 billion loss, Ps.559.6 billion lower than the previous quarter and Ps.397.3 billion lower YoY
mainly due to the mark to market of Government Securities (financial assets at fair value through profit or loss) and lower fx gains.
<B>If Government Securities included in financial assets at fair value through profit or loss (namely TZX27 bonds) had been valued at
amortized cost 2Q24 net income would have been Ps.605.5 billion higher</B>.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">As of 2Q24 the
accumulated result represented an annualized ROAE and ROAA of 5.4% and 1.7% respectively.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Net operating
income</B> (before G&amp;A and personnel expenses) was Ps.460.2 billion in 2Q24, 76% or Ps.1.46 trillion lower compared to 1Q24. On a
yearly basis, Net Operating Income (before G&amp;A and personnel expenses) decreased 53% or Ps.521.1 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 2Q24, <B>Provision
for loan losses</B> totaled Ps.16.5 billion, 26% or Ps.5.9 billion lower than in 1Q24. On a yearly basis provision for loan losses decreased
20% or Ps.4 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Operating income
</B>(after G&amp;A and personnel expenses) was Ps.99.1 billion in 2Q24, 93% or Ps.1.4 trillion lower than in 1Q24 and 85% or Ps.544 billion
lower than a year ago.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>The Bank&rsquo;s
2Q24 net interest income </B>totaled Ps.188 billion, 6% or Ps.12.7 billion lower than in 1Q24 and 53% or Ps.213.1 billion lower YoY.
Interest income decreased 27% while interest expenses decreased 33%.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>In 2Q24 interest
income</B> totaled Ps.619.7 billion, 27% or Ps.229.8 billion lower than in 1Q24 and 46% or Ps.521.4 billion lower than in 2Q23.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Income from
interest on loans and other financing </B>totaled Ps.410.2 billion, 26% or Ps142.7 billion lower compared with the previous quarter mainly
due to a 25.9% percentage points decrease in the average lending rate which was partially offset by a 9% increase in the average volume
of private sector loans. On a yearly basis Income from interest on loans decreased 10% or Ps.45.2 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 2Q24, <B>income
from government and private securities</B> increased 40% or Ps.44.7 billion QoQ and decreased 74% or Ps.457.2billion compared with the
same period of last year. This result is explained 99% by income from government and private securities valued at amortized cost and
the remaining 1% is explained by income from government and private securities through other comprehensive income (Other government securities)</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

ago.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 2Q24 <B>FX income
totaled </B>Ps.25.6 billion,73% or Ps.69.9 billion lower than the previous quarter and 91% or Ps.256.1 billion lower than a year ago.
FX income gain was due to the 6.3% argentine peso depreciation against the US dollar and the Bank&rsquo;s long dollar position during
the quarter. It is important to notice that the Bank&rsquo;s average long dollar position decreased 59% during the quarter.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: italic 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The Bank&rsquo;s
2Q24 <B>interest expense</B> totaled Ps.431.7 billion, decreasing 33% or Ps.217.1 billion compared to the previous quarter and 42% (Ps.308.3
billion) lower compared to 2Q23.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 2Q24, <B>interest
on deposits </B>represented 97% of the Bank&rsquo;s total interest expense, decreasing 33% or Ps.208.8 billion QoQ, due to a 25.4 percentage
points decrease in the average rate paid on deposits while the average volume of deposits from the private sector increased 16%. On a
yearly basis, interest on deposits decreased 42% or Ps.304.5billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 2Q24 <B>Banco
Macro&rsquo;s net fee income </B>totaled Ps.95.7 billion, 8% or Ps.6.8 billion higher than in 1Q24 and was 2% or Ps.2.1 billion lower
than the same period of last year.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In the quarter,
<B>fee income </B>totaled Ps.112.1 billion, 11% or Ps.11.2 billion higher than in 1Q24. In the quarter fees charged on deposit accounts
increased 14% or Ps.5 billion, credit related fees increased 57% or Ps.2.6 billion, ATM transactions fees increased 34% or Ps.2.1 billion
and insurance fees increased 31% or Ps.1.3 billion. On a yearly basis, fee income increased 3% or Ps.3.7 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In the quarter,
<B>total fee expense</B> increased 37% or Ps4.5 billion, mainly due to higher ATM networks fees. On a yearly basis, fee expenses increased
58% or Ps.5.8 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

receivables decreased Ps.5.8 billion while income from initial recognition of financial assets and liabilities decreased 129% or Ps.7.9
billion. Others increased 84% or Ps.5.6 billion while other service related fees increased 25% or Ps.3.5 billion. On a yearly basis,
Other Operating Income increased 62% or Ps.17.8 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 2Q24 <B>Banco
Macro&rsquo;s administrative expenses plus employee benefits</B> totaled Ps.203.5 billion, 15% or Ps.35.3 billion lower than the previous
quarter, due to lower employee benefits (-14%) and lower (-17%) administrative expenses. On a yearly basis, administrative expenses plus
employee benefits increased 14% or Ps.25.6 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Employee benefits
</B>decreased 14% or Ps.21.7 billion QoQ, remunerations decreased 14% or Ps.15.3 billion while Compensation and bonuses decreased 20%
or Ps.3.9 billion. On a yearly basis, Employee benefits increased 20% or Ps.22.4 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 2Q24, <B>administrative
expenses </B>decreased 17% or Ps.13.6 billion, due to lower Directors and auditors fees(-163%) which were partially offset by higher
taxes (+34%). On a yearly basis administrative expenses increased 5% or Ps.3.2 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 2Q24, <B>the
efficiency ratio </B>reached 55.9%, deteriorating significantly from the 14.6% posted in 1Q24 and the 21.7% posted a year ago. In 2Q24
expenses (employee benefits + G&amp;A expenses + depreciation and impairment of assets) decreased 14%, while income (net interest income
+ net fee income + differences in quoted prices of gold and foreign currency + other operating income + net income from financial assets
at fair value through profit or loss &ndash; (Turnover Tax + Insurance on deposits)) decreased 77% compared to 1Q24.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>In 2Q24, the
result from the net monetary position totaled a Ps.462.7 billion loss, 56% or Ps.591.3 billion lower than the loss posted in 1Q24 and
14% or Ps.56.1 billion higher than the loss posted one year ago. </B> This result is a consequence of lower inflation during the quarter
(inflation tumbled to 18.6% from 51.6% in 1Q24) while the net monetary position remained unchanged.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Loans and other
financing</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>The volume of
financing</B> (including loans, financial trust and leasing portfolio) totaled Ps.3.47 triillion, increasing 17% or Ps.504.1 billion
QoQ and 5% or Ps.154.5 billion YoY. In 2Q24 Private sector loans increased 15% or Ps.449.4 billion. On a yearly basis Private sector
loans increased 5% or Ps.150 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Within commercial
loans, Documents </B>stand out with a 7% or Ps.43.6 billion increase, while <B>Others</B> increased 27% or Ps.158.3 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Within <B>consumer
lending, personal loans</B> increased 29% or Ps.111.9 billion while <B>credit card loans</B> increased 11% or Ps.77.8 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Within <B>private
sector financing, </B>peso financing increased 20% or Ps.463.8 billion, while US dollar financing increased USD 2 million.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">As of 2Q24, <B>Banco
Macro&rsquo;s market share over private sector loans</B> was 9.1%.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In
1Q24, the <B>Bank&rsquo;s public sector assets </B>to total assets ratio was 41.8%, lower than the 47.3% registered in the previous quarter,
and higher than the 22.4% posted in 2Q23. Other government securities decreased 13% or Ps.740.4 billion (dual Bonds) which were partially
offset by a Ps.40.9 billion increase in Provincial loans (Loan extended to the Province of Salta).</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Deposits</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Banco Macro&rsquo;s
deposit base </B>totaled Ps.6.74 trillion in 2Q24, increasing 13% or Ps.769.5 billion QoQ and decreased 5% or Ps.329.3 billion YoY and
representing 79% of the Bank&rsquo;s total liabilities.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">On a quarterly
basis <B>private sector deposits </B>increased 11% or Ps.591.5 billion while <B>public sector deposits</B> increased 30% or Ps.181.9
billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The increase in
private sector deposits was led by <B>demand deposits</B>, which increased 23% or Ps.581.5 billion, while time deposits decreased 2%
or Ps.54.5 billion QoQ.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Within private
sector deposits, <B>peso deposits </B>increased 17% or Ps.774.6 billion, while US dollar deposits decreased 6% or USD 97 million.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">As of 2Q24, <B>Banco
Macro&acute;s market share </B>over private sector deposits was 8.1%.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Other sources of
funds</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 2Q24, the total
amount of <B>other sources of funds</B> decreased 19% or Ps.862.6 billion compared to 1Q24 mainly due to a 20% or Ps.791.1 billion decrease
in Shareholders&rsquo; equity generated by the <B>negative net </B>income registered during the period (Ps.281.2 billion and Ps.507.6
billion paid in dividends). Subordinated corporate bonds decreased 12% or Ps.49.7 billion. On a yearly basis, <B>other sources of funds
</B>increased 15% or Ps.469.5 billion.</FONT></P>

showing <B>high solvency levels</B> in 2Q24 with an integrated capital (RPC) of Ps.3.1 trillion over a total capital requirement of Ps.696.4
billion. <B>Banco Macro&rsquo;s excess capital</B> in 2Q24 was 338% or Ps.2.36 trillion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 2Q24, <B>Banco
Macro&rsquo;s non-performing </B>to total financing ratio (under Central Bank rules) reached a level of 1.23%, up from 1.14% in 1Q24
and improving from the 1.37% posted in 2Q23.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Consumer portfolio
non-</B>performing loans deteriorated 5 b.p. (up to 1.52% from 1.47%) while <B>Commercial portfolio non-performing loans</B> deteriorated
1 b.p. in 2Q24 (up to 0.73% from 0.72%).</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>The coverage
ratio</B> (measured as total allowances under Expected Credit Losses over Non Performing loans under Central Bank rules) reached 181.4%
in 2Q24. Write-offs over <B>total loans</B> totaled 0.04%.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The Bank is committed
to continue working in this area to maintain excellent asset quality standards.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Expected Credit Losses (E.C.L) (I.F.R.S.9)</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The Bank records
an allowance for expected credit losses for all loans and other debt financial assets not held at fair value through profit or loss,
together with loan commitments and financial guarantee contracts, in this section all referred to as &lsquo;financial instruments&rsquo;.
Equity instruments are not subject to impairment under IFRS 9. The ECL allowance is based on the credit losses expected to arise over
the life of the asset (the lifetime expected credit loss), unless there has been no significant increase in credit risk since origination,
in which case, the allowance is based on the 12 months expected credit loss.(For further information please see our 2023 20-F)</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

                                            Repos&nbsp;&amp; LEFi</P>

    July&nbsp;through communication &ldquo;A&rdquo; 8060 the Central Bank of Argentina decided to end Repos and substitute them with
    LEFis (Fiscal Liquidity bills)</FONT></P>
    <P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0">&nbsp;</P>
    <P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">As
    of July&nbsp;22, 2024 financial institutions are able to invest in LeFis from the Central Bank, issued by the Tresury:</FONT></P>
    <P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0">&nbsp;</P>
    <P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: -0.25in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Issued
    by the National Tresury.</FONT></FONT></P>
    <P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: -0.25in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">1
    year duration.</FONT></FONT></P>
    <P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: -0.25in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">monetary
    policy rate as established by the BCRA.</FONT></FONT></P>
    <P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: -0.25in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Transferrable
    and negotiable only between financial institutions and the BCRA.</FONT></FONT></P>
    <P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: -0.25in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Can

                                            Minimum Reserve Requirements</P>
    <P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
    <P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In May&nbsp;2024,
through Communication &ldquo;A&rdquo; 8026 the Central Bank established that reserve requirement in pesos facilities through granting
financing within the &ldquo;Ahora 12&rdquo; and &ldquo;cuota simple&rdquo;programs, are terminated. Financial institutions can continue
to compute the requirement for balances prior to May&nbsp;23. Also, credit card financing rate limits for individuals are also terminated
as of June&nbsp;2024. As of that moment, the interest rate for credit card financing cannot surpass the 25% of that which results from
